chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Musanna, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Hajj is during known months: Shawwal, Dhu al-Qadah, and Dhu al-Hijjah. It is not for anyone to enter the state of Ihram for Hajj in months other than these, and it is not for anyone to enter Ihram before the time designated by the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). Indeed, the example of that is like the one who prays four (rak'ahs) during travel and leaves the two (rak'ahs).
ai.seo_question: What are the specific months for Hajj and when should one enter Ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi delineates the precise temporal boundaries for Hajj, specifying Shawwal, Dhu al-Qadah, and Dhu al-Hijjah as the 'known months' for entering Ihram, while prohibiting premature commitment. The analogy to shortening travel prayer (Qasr) underscores the legal principle that deviating from the Prophet's established timing renders the ritual irregular, a view supported by Shia jurists who emphasize the strict adherence to the Sunnah's chronological framework for pilgrimage rites.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Musna, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The Hajj is during known months – Shawwal, and Zilqadah, and Zilhijja. It is not for anyone that he wears Ihraam for the Hajj during other that these, and it is not for anyone that he wears Ihraam besides the junctures which Rasool-Allahsaww designated. So, rather, the example of that is like the one who Prays four (Cycles) during the journey and leaves the (Praying of) two (Cycles)’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr from Muthanna’ from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

The months of al-Hajj are well known; they are Shawwal, Dhu al-Qa’dah and Dhu al-Hajj ah. One must not assume the state of Ihram for al-Hajj in other months and one must not assume the state of Ihram before Mawaqit (places for assuming the state of Ihram) designated by the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause. To do so is like performing four Rak‘ats Salat (prayer) on a journey and ignoring the fact that one’s duty is to perform two Rak‘ats only.’”
